parents.subject: Social Work
parents.course: Special Studies in Soc Work I

ns2:section.sectionText: Participants will explore current issues in the field related to the intersection between young children with disabilities and trauma. Specifically, topics will focus on the provision of trauma-informed care, work with families, self-care, prevention, and building awareness related to the connection between trauma and disability. Additionally, there will be a focus on cross-disciplinary work to enhance services for young children.
